Achiever.name: Achiever
Achiever.description: An ActualResource, ActualProject or ActualStrategicPhase that can deliver a desired effect.

Achieves.name: Achieves
Achieves.description: A dependency relationship that exists between an ActualState (e.g., observed/measured during testing) of an element that attempts to achieve a desired effect and an Achiever.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «Achiever».
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «ActualState».

Activity.name: Activity
Activity.description: An abstract element that represents a behavior or process (i.e. a Function or OperationalActivity) that can be performed by a Performer.

ActualCondition.name: ActualCondition
ActualCondition.description: An actual situation with respect to circumstances under which an OperationalActivity, Function or ServiceFunction can be performed.
constraints: Value for the classifier metaproperty has to be stereotyped «Condition» or its specializations.

ActualEffect.name: ActualEffect
ActualEffect.description: A real world phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon.

properties.name: enablingCondition
properties.description: Condition under which the Effect can be achieved.

constraints: Value for the classifier metaproperty must be stereotyped by «Effect» or its specializations.

ActualEnduringTask.name: ActualEnduringTask
ActualEnduringTask.description: An actual undertaking recognized by an enterprise as being essential to achieving its goals - i.e. a strategic specification of what the enterprise does.

ActualEnterprisePhase.name: ActualEnterprisePhase
ActualEnterprisePhase.description: A time period within which a set of Capabilities are deployed.

properties.name: statementTask
properties.description: Relates the ActualEnterprisePhase to the ActualEnduringTasks that are intended to be implemented during that phase.

ActualEnvironment.name: ActualEnvironment
constraints: Value for the classifier metaproperty has to be stereotyped «Environment» or its specializations.

ActualLocation.name: ActualLocation
ActualLocation.description: A physical location, for example using text to provide an address, Geo-coordinates, etc.

properties.name: address
properties.description: String describing the address of the ActualLocation, i.e. "1600 Pennsylvania avenue",  "The White House"

properties.name: locationKind
properties.description: Enumerated value describing the kind of ActualLocation.

properties.name: customKind
properties.description: String describing a location kind that is not in the LocationKind enumerated list

properties.name: locationNamedByAddress
properties.description: Boolean that indicates if the ActualLocation address is embedded in the ActualLocation name.  By default = false.

constraints: Classifier metaproperty value must be stereotyped «Location» or its specializations.

ActualMeasurement.name: ActualMeasurement
ActualMeasurement.description: An actual value that is applied to a Measurement.

properties.name: intention
properties.description: Enumerated value describing the intent of the ActualMeasurement.

constraints: Value for the definingFeature metaproperty must be stereotyped «Measurement» or its specializations.
Value for the owningInstance metaproperty must be stereotyped «ActualPropertySet» or its specializations.

ActualMeasurementSet.name: ActualMeasurementSet

properties.name: appliesFor
properties.description: Relates the ActualMeasurementSet to the elements that are being measured.

constraints: Classifier metaproperty value must be stereotyped «MeasurementSet» or its specializations.
Value for the slot metaproperty must be stereotyped «ActualMeasurement» or its specializations.

ActualMission.name: ActualMission
ActualMission.description: A particular mission to accomplish assigned mission objectives
constraints: Value for the classifier metaproperty must be stereotyped by «Mission» or its specializations.

ActualMissionPhase.name: ActualMissionPhase
ActualMissionPhase.description: A particular phase in the accomplishment of an overall actual mission

ActualMissionScenario.name: ActualMissionScenario
ActualMissionScenario.description: A particular Mission Scenario within which an Actual Mission is to be accomplished
constraints: Value for the classifier metaproperty has to be stereotyped «MissionScenario» or its specializations.

ActualMissionVignette.name: ActualMissionVignette
ActualMissionVignette.description: A particular Mission Vignette within which an Actual Mission is to be accomplished
constraints: Value for the classifier metaproperty has to be stereotyped «MissionVignette» or its specializations.

ActualOrganization.name: ActualOrganization
ActualOrganization.description: An actual formal or informal organizational unit, e.g. "Driving and Vehicle Licensing Agency", "UAF team Alpha".

properties.name: shortName
properties.description: String providing a simplified means of identifying an ActualOrganization, i.e. SoftWareGroup could use SWG as the shortName.

properties.name: serviceType
properties.description: Service office code or symbol

constraints: Classifier metaproperty value must be stereotyped «Organization» or its specializations.
Slot metaproperty value must be stereotyped «ActualOrganizationRole» or its specializations.

ActualOrganizationRole.name: ActualOrganizationRole
ActualOrganizationRole.description: An ActualOrganizationalResource that is applied to a ResourceRole.
constraints: Value for owningInstance metaproperty has to be stereotyped «ActualOrganization» or its specializations.

ActualOrganizationalResource.name: ActualOrganizationalResource
ActualOrganizationalResource.description: Abstract element for an ActualOrganization, ActualPerson or ActualPost.

properties.name: publishedStandards
properties.description: A relationship between an actual organization and the standards published by that organization

properties.name: ratifiedStandards
properties.description: Standards that were ratified by this ActualOrganization.

properties.name: createdStandards
properties.description: A relationship between an actual organization and the standards created by that organization

ActualOutcome.name: ActualOutcome
ActualOutcome.description: Something that happens or is produced as the final consequence or product and is related to one of the goals for the business or enterprise. Outcome is a special kind of effect, one that is usually at the end of a chain of effects, i.e. an "end effect".

ActualPerson.name: ActualPerson
constraints: Value for the classifier metaproperty has to be stereotyped «Person» or its specializations.

ActualPost.name: ActualPost
ActualPost.description: An actual, specific post, an instance of a Post "type" - e.g., "President of the United States of America." where the Post would be president.
constraints: Classifier metaproperty value must be stereotyped «Post» or its specializations.

ActualProject.name: ActualProject
ActualProject.description: A time-limited planned endeavor executed by an ActualOrganization responsible for developing, deploying or decommissioning ResourcePerformers in accordance with ActualProjectMilestones.

properties.name: ownedMilestone
properties.description: Relates the ActualProjectMilestones to the relevant ActualProject.

properties.name: projectKind
properties.description: Enumerated value describing the kind of ActualProject.

constraints: Value for the classifier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Project» or its specializations.
Value for the slot metaproperty must be stereotyped «ActualProjectRole», «ActualProjectMilestoneRole», or their specializations.

ActualProjectMilestone.name: ActualProjectMilestone
ActualProjectMilestone.description: An event with a start date in a ActualProject from which progress is measured.

properties.name: actualResource
properties.description: Relates an ActualProjectMilestone to the  ActualResources that are affected by the milestone. It is used to describe aspects of the lifecycle of an ActualResource.

properties.name: endDate
properties.description: End time for this ActualProjectMilestone.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Enumerated value describing the kind of ActualProjectMilestone.

constraints: Value for the classifier metaproperty must be stereotyped «ProjectMilestone» or its specializations.

ActualProjectMilestoneRole.name: ActualProjectMilestoneRole
ActualProjectMilestoneRole.description: An ActualProjectMilestone that is applied to a ProjectMilestoneRole.
constraints: Value for the definingFeature metaproperty has to be stereotyped «ProjectMilestoneRole» or its specializations.
Value for the owningInstance metaproperty has to be stereotyped «ActualProject» or its specializations.
Value for the value.instance metaproperty has to be stereotyped «ActualProjectMilestone» or its specializations.

ActualProjectRole.name: ActualProjectRole
ActualProjectRole.description: An ActualProject that is applied to a ProjectRole.
constraints: Value for the definingFeature metaproperty has to be stereotyped «ProjectRole» or its specializations.
Value for the owningInstance metaproperty has to be stereotyped «ActualProject» or its specializations.
Value for the value.instance metaproperty has to be stereotyped «ActualProject» or its specializations.

ActualPropertySet.name: ActualPropertySet
ActualPropertySet.description: A set or collection of Actual properties.
constraints: Value for the classifier metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «PropertySet».

ActualResource.name: ActualResource
ActualResource.description: An instance of a ResourcePerformer in the real world.

properties.name: milestone
properties.description: Relates an ActualResource to the  ActualProjectMilestones. It is used to describe aspects of the lifecycle of an ActualResource.

properties.name: actualCondition
properties.description: Relates the ActualResource to the ActualStates of an environment or location describing its situation

constraints: Classifier metaproperty value must be stereotyped by a specialization of «ResourcePerformer».

ActualResourceRelationship.name: ActualResourceRelationship
ActualResourceRelationship.description: An abstract element that details the ActualOrganizationalResources that are able to carry out an ActualResponsibility.
constraints: Value for informationSource metaproperty must be stereotyped «ActualResource» or its specializations.
Value for realizes metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceExchange» or its specializations.
Value for informationTarget metaproperty must be stereotyped «ActualResource» or its specializations.

ActualResourceRole.name: ActualResourceRole
constraints: Value for definingFeature metaproperty has to be stereotyped «ResourceRole» or its specializations.
Value for owningInstance metaproperty has to be stereotyped «ActualResource» or its specializations.

ActualResponsibility.name: ActualResponsibility
ActualResponsibility.description: The duty required of a Person or Organization.
constraints: Classifier metaproperty value must be stereotyped «Responsibility» or its specializations.

ActualResponsibleResource.name: ActualResponsibleResource
ActualResponsibleResource.description: An abstract grouping of responsible OrganizationalResources.

ActualRisk.name: ActualRisk
ActualRisk.description: An instance of a Risk. A value holder for Risk Measurements.

properties.name: actualRiskOwner
properties.description: Enables association of an ActualRisk to an actual organizational role that is responsible for executing the actual mitigation.

properties.name: affectedActualResource
properties.description: Asserts that an ActualRisk is applicable to an ActualResource.

constraints: Value for the classifier metaproperty must be stereotyped by «Risk» or its specializations.

ActualService.name: ActualService
constraints: Value for the classifier metaproperty must be stereotyped by «Service» or its specializations.

ActualState.name: ActualState
ActualState.description: Abstract element that applies temporal extent to a set of elements realized as Instance Specifications.

properties.name: endDate
properties.description: End time for all "actual" elements.

properties.name: startDate
properties.description: Start time for all "actual" elements.

ActualStrategicPhase.name: ActualStrategicPhase
ActualStrategicPhase.description: A phase of an actual enterprise, mission, ValueStream or EnduringTask endeavor.
constraints: Value for the classifier metaproperty must be stereotyped by «StrategicPhase» or its specializations.
Must fall within the start and end dates of the enclosing ActualStrategicPhase having this ActualStrategicPhase set as a value for a slot.

AffectableElement.name: AffectableElement
AffectableElement.description: An abstract grouping of elements that can be affected by Risk.

Affects.name: Affects
Affects.description: A dependency that asserts that a Risk is applicable to an Asset.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «Risk» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «AffectableElement» or its specializations.

AffectsInContext.name: AffectsInContext
AffectsInContext.description: A dependency that asserts that a Risk is applicable to an AssetRole in the specific context or configuration.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «Risk» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «AssetRole» or its specializations.

Alias.name: Alias
Alias.description: A metamodel Artifact used to define an alternative name for an element.

properties.name: nameOwner
properties.description: Someone or something that uses this alternative name.

constraints: Value for the annotatedElement metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «UAFElement».

ArbitraryConnector.name: ArbitraryConnector
ArbitraryConnector.description: Represents a visual indication of a connection used in high level operational concept diagrams.
constraints: The value for client metaproperty has to be stereotyped «ConceptRole» or its specializations.
The value for supplier metaproperty has to be stereotyped «ConceptRole» or its specializations.

ArchitecturalDescription.name: ArchitecturalDescription
ArchitecturalDescription.description:
An Architecture Description is a work product used to express the Architecture of some System Of Interest.
It provides executive-level summary information about the architecture description in a consistent form to allow quick reference and comparison between architecture descriptions -- It includes assumptions, constraints, and limitations that may affect high-level decisions relating to an architecture-based work program.

properties.name: approvalAuthority
properties.description: Someone or something that has the authority to approve the ArchitecturalDescription.

properties.name: architect
properties.description: Someone responsible for the creation of ArchitecturalDescription.

properties.name: assumptionAndConstraint
properties.description: Any assumptions, constraints, and limitations contained in the ArchitecturalDescription, including those affecting deployment, communications performance, information assurance environments, etc.

properties.name: creatingOrganization
properties.description: The organization responsible for creating the ArchitecturalDescription.

properties.name: dateCompleted
properties.description: Date that the ArchitecturalDescription was completed.

properties.name: purpose
properties.description: Explains the need for the Architecture, what it will demonstrate, the types of analyses that will be applied to it, who is expected to perform the analyses, what decisions are expected to be made on the basis of each form of analysis, who is expected to make those decisions, and what actions are expected to result.

properties.name: recommendations
properties.description: States the recommendations that have been developed based on the architecture effort. Examples include recommended system implementations, and opportunities for technology insertion.

properties.name: summaryOfFindings
properties.description: Summarizes the findings that have been developed so far. This may be updated several times during the development of the ArchitecturalDescription.

properties.name: toolsUsed
properties.description: Identifies any tools used to develop the ArchitecturalDescription as well as file names and formats if appropriate.

properties.name: toBe
properties.description: Indicates whether the ArchitecturalDescription represents an Architecture that exists or will exist in the future.

properties.name: architectureFramework
properties.description: Indicates the type of framework used.

properties.name: view
properties.description: Indicates which views are used in the ArchitecturalDescription.

properties.name: viewpoint
properties.description: The architecture viewpoints used when developing the architecture description.

properties.name: methodologyUsed
properties.description: Name of the documented methodology that will be or has been used in describing the architecture.

properties.name: status
properties.description: State of the architecture description in terms of its development, baselining, activity (e.g. active or inactive), or some other factor of importance.

properties.name: version
properties.description: Identifier that indicates the particular edition or revision of the architecture description.

ArchitecturalReference.name: ArchitecturalReference
ArchitecturalReference.description: A dependency relationship that specifies that one architectural description refers to another.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ArchitecturalDescription» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «ArchitecturalDescription» or its specializations.

Architecture.name: Architecture
Architecture.description: An abstract type that represents a generic architecture. Subtypes are OperationalArchitecture, Service Architecture, and ResourceArchitecture.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.description: The description of an Architecture.

ArchitectureMetadata.name: ArchitectureMetadata
ArchitectureMetadata.description: Information associated with an ArchitecturalDescription, that supplements the standard set of tags used to summarize the Architecture. It states things like what methodology was used, notation, etc.
constraints: Value for the annotatedElement metaproperty must be stereotyped «ArchitecturalDescription» or its specializations.

Asset.name: Asset
Asset.description: An abstract element that indicates the types of elements that can be affected by Risk. Asset as applied to Security views is an abstract element that indicates the types of elements that can be considered as a subject for security analysis.

properties.name: categoryCategorizesAsset
properties.description: Enables association of an Asset to the set of security related measurements (MeasurementSet).

AssetRole.name: AssetRole
AssetRole.description: An abstract element that indicates the types of elements that can be affected by Risk in the particular context. AssetRole as applied to Security views, is an abstract element that indicates the type of elements that can be considered as a subject for security analysis in the particular context.

Capability.name: Capability
Capability.description: An enterprise's ability to Achieve a desired effect realized through a combination of ways and means (e.g. CapabilityConfigurations) along with specified measures.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Selection of the enumerated kind for this element.

properties.name: customKind
properties.description: Identification of a special kind of Capability that is different from one of the predefined enumerated kinds.

CapabilityConfiguration.name: CapabilityConfiguration
CapabilityConfiguration.description: A composite structure representing the physical and human resources (and their interactions) in an enterprise, assembled to meet a capability.

properties.name: doctrine
properties.description: Represents the doctrinal line of development of the Capability.

CapabilityRole.name: CapabilityRole
CapabilityRole.description: Property of a Capability typed by another Capability, enabling whole-part relationships and structures.
constraints: Value for class metaproperty must be stereotyped «Capability» or its specializations.
Value for type metaproperty must be stereotyped «Capability» or its specializations.

CapableElement.name: CapableElement
CapableElement.description: An abstract type that represents a structural element that can exhibit capabilities.

Challenge.name: Challenge
Challenge.description: An existing or potential difficulty, circumstance, or obstacle which will require effort and determination from an enterprise to overcome in achieving its goals.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Selection of the enumerated kind for this element.

Command.name: Command
Command.description: A type of ResourceExchange that asserts that one OrganizationalResource commands another.
constraints: Value for the informationSource metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «OrganizationalResource».
Value for the informationTarget metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «OrganizationalResource».
Value for the conveyed metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceInformation» or its specializations.

ComparesTo.name: ComparesTo
ComparesTo.description: An abstraction relationship relating the effect that is achieved with the originally expected DesiredEffect. Providing a means of comparison, between the expectation of the desirer and the actual result.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «ActualState».
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «ActualState».

Competence.name: Competence
Competence.description: A specific set of abilities defined by knowledge, skills and aptitude.

CompetenceForRole.name: CompetenceForRole
CompetenceForRole.description: An abstraction relationship used to associate an organizational role with a specific set of required competencies.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceRole» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Competence» or its specializations.

CompetenceToConduct.name: CompetenceToConduct
CompetenceToConduct.description: An abstraction relationship used to associate a Function with a specific set of Competencies needed to conduct the Function.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «Function» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Competence» or its specializations.

ConceptItem.name: ConceptItem
ConceptItem.description: An abstract type which represents some part played by an asset or location in a HighLevelOperationalConcept.

ConceptRole.name: ConceptRole
ConceptRole.description: Usage of a ConceptItem in the context of a HighLevelOperationalConcept.
constraints: Value for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped by a specialization of «ConceptItem».
Value for the class metaproperty must be stereotyped «HighLevelOperationalConcept» or its specializations.

Concern.name: Concern
Concern.description: A matter of relevance or importance to a stakeholder regarding an entity of interest.

Condition.name: Condition
Condition.description: A type that defines the Location, Environment and/or GeoPoliticalExtent.

ConflictsWith.name: ConflictsWith
ConflictsWith.description: An annotation that indicates UAF elements acting against or in opposition to each other. This means that there are elements in the model that disagree about something important or are incompatible with each other in some way
constraints: Value for the annotatedElement metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «UAFElement».

Control.name: Control
Control.description: A type of ResourceExchange that asserts that one PhysicalResource controls another PhysicalResource (i.e.  the driver of a vehicle controlling the vehicle speed or direction).
constraints: Value for the conveyed metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceInformation» or its specializations.
Value for the informationTarget metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «PhysicalResource» or its specializations.
Value for the informationSource metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «PhysicalResource».

Creates.name: Creates
Creates.description: A dependency relationship denoting that an ActualStrategicPhase brings into existence a StrategicAsset.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ActualOutcome» or its specializations, or any of specializations of «ActualStrategicPhase».
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «StrategicAsset».

Defines.name: Defines
Defines.description: A tuple that links the StrategicPhase and the Activity that implements it
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «Activity».
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «StrategicPhase» or its specializations.

Definition.name: Definition
Definition.description: A comment containing a description of an element in the architecture.

properties.name: author
properties.description: The original or current person (architect) responsible for the Definition.

constraints: Value for the annotatedElement metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «UAFElement».

DesignationKind.name: DesignationKind
DesignationKind.description: An enumerated type that defines the kind of structural element with respect to purpose, intent and capabilities of that element

Desirer.name: Desirer
Desirer.description: Abstract element used to group architecture elements that might desire a particular effect.

Desires.name: Desires
Desires.description: A dependency relationship relating the Desirer (a Capability or OrganizationalResource) to an ActualState.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped a specialization of «Desirer».
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped a specialization of «ActualState».

Doctrine.name: Doctrine
Doctrine.description: A formal expression of military knowledge and thought, accepted as being relevant at a given time, which covers the nature of conflict, the preparation of the military forces for conflict, and the method of engaging in conflict to achieve success. it is descriptive rather than prescriptive, requiring judgment in application.

Driver.name: Driver
Driver.description: A factor which will have a significant impact on the activities, and goals of an enterprise

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Selection of the enumerated kind for this element.

Effect.name: Effect
Effect.description: A kind of phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon that could lead to downstream effects or to one or more desired outcomes

Enables.name: Enables
Enables.description: A dependency relationship denoting that an Opportunity provides the means for achieving an EnterpriseGoal or Objective.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «Opportunity».
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «EnterpriseGoal» or its specializations.

EnhancedSecurityControl.name: EnhancedSecurityControl
EnhancedSecurityControl.description: Statement of security capability to: (i) build in additional but related, functionality to a basic control; and/or (ii)increase the strength of a basic control.

Enhances.name: Enhances
Enhances.description: A dependency relationship relating the EnhancedSecurityControl to a SecurityControl.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «EnhancedSecurityControl» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «SecurityControl» or its specializations.

EnterpriseGoal.name: EnterpriseGoal
EnterpriseGoal.description: A statement about a state or condition of the enterprise to be brought about or sustained through appropriate Means. An EnterpriseGoal amplifies an EnterpriseVision that is, it indicates what must be satisfied on a continuing basis to effectively attain the EnterpriseVision. http://www.omg.org/spec/BMM/1.3/

properties.name: benefit
properties.description: An advantage or profit gained from achieving the EnterpriseGoal.

EnterpriseObjective.name: EnterpriseObjective
EnterpriseObjective.description: A statement of an attainable, time-targeted, and measurable target that the enterprise seeks to meet in order to achieve its Goals. http://www.omg.org/spec/BMM/1.3/

EnterpriseVision.name: EnterpriseVision
EnterpriseVision.description: A Vision describes the future state of the enterprise, without regard to how it is to be achieved. http://www.omg.org/spec/BMM/1.3/

properties.name: statement
properties.description: A description of the Vision.

Environment.name: Environment
Environment.description: A definition of the environmental factors in which something exists or functions. The definition of an Environment element can be further defined using  EnvironmentKind.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Captures the kind of Environment.

EnvironmentProperty.name: EnvironmentProperty
EnvironmentProperty.description: A property of an Environment that is typed by a  Condition.  The kinds of Condition that can be represented are Location, GeoPoliticalExtentType and Environment.
constraints: Value for the class metaproperty must be stereotyped «PropertySet» or its specializations.
Value for the type property must be stereotyped «Condition» or its specializations.

EvokedBy.name: EvokedBy
EvokedBy.description: A dependency relationship denoting that a Risk is drawn out by an Opportunity.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «Risk» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Opportunity» or its specializations.

Exchange.name: Exchange
Exchange.description: Abstract grouping for OperationalExchanges and ResourceExchanges that exchange Resources.

Exhibits.name: Exhibits
Exhibits.description: An abstraction relationship that exists between a CapableElement and a Capability that it meets under specific environmental conditions.

properties.name: environmentalConditions
properties.description: Defines the environmental conditions constraining the way that a Capability is exhibited.

constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped a specialization of «CapableElement».
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Capability».

FieldedCapability.name: FieldedCapability
FieldedCapability.description: An actual, fully-realized capability. A FieldedCapability is typed by a CapabilityConfiguration.
constraints: Value for the classifier metaproperty must be stereotyped «CapabilityConfiguration» or its specializations.

FillsPost.name: FillsPost
FillsPost.description: A dependency relationship that asserts that an ActualPerson fills an ActualPost.

properties.name: startDate
properties.description: Start date of an ActualPerson filling an ActualPost.

properties.name: endDate
properties.description: End date of an ActualPerson filling an ActualPost.

constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by «ActualPerson» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped by «ActualPost» or its specializations.

Forecast.name: Forecast
Forecast.description: A dependency relationship that specifies a transition from one Resource Performer, Standard, Competence to another future one. It is related to an ActualStrategicPhase to give it a temporal context.

properties.name: forecastPeriod
properties.description: Relates the SubjectOfForecast to the ActualStrategicPhase in which the SubjectOfForecast is expected to be provided.

constraints: Value for the supplier property must be stereotyped by the specialization of «SubjectOfForecast».
Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «SubjectOfForecast».
Values for the client and supplier metaproperties must be stereotyped by the same specialization of «SubjectOfForecast» (e.g. «Software» to «Software», «Standard» to «Standard», etc).

Function.name: Function
Function.description: An Activity which is specified in the context to the ResourcePerformer (human or machine) that IsCapableToPerform it.

properties.name: affectedResource
properties.description: ResourceExchangeItems consumed and produced internally within a Function.

constraints: The values for the ownedParameter metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceParameter» or its specializations.

FunctionAction.name: FunctionAction
FunctionAction.description: A call of a Function indicating that the  Function is performed by a ResourceRole in a specific context.
constraints: Value for the activity metaproperty must be stereotyped «Function» or its specializations.
Value for the behavior metaproperty must be stereotyped «Function» or its specializations.

FunctionControlFlow.name: FunctionControlFlow
FunctionControlFlow.description: An ActivityEdge that shows the flow of control between FunctionActions.
constraints: Value for the source metaproperty must be stereotyped «FunctionAction» or its specializations.
Value for the target metaproperty must be stereotyped «FunctionAction» or its specializations.

FunctionEdge.name: FunctionEdge
FunctionEdge.description: Abstract grouping for FunctionControlFlow and FunctionObjectFlow.
constraints: «FunctionEdge» must be owned directly or indirectly by «Function» or its specializations.

FunctionObjectFlow.name: FunctionObjectFlow
FunctionObjectFlow.description: An ActivityEdge that shows the flow of Resources (objects/data) between FunctionActions.

GeoPoliticalExtentType.name: GeoPoliticalExtentType
GeoPoliticalExtentType.description: A type of geospatial extent whose boundaries are defined by declaration or agreement by political parties.

properties.name: customKind
properties.description: Captures the kind of GeopoliticalExtentType if the GeoPoliticalExtentTypeKind has been set to "OtherType".

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Captures the kind of GeopoliticalExtentType.

GovernedBy.name: GovernedBy
GovernedBy.description: An abstraction relationship that exists between the ServiceContract and the Service that it governs.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «Service» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceContract» or its specializations.

HighLevelOperationalConcept.name: HighLevelOperationalConcept
HighLevelOperationalConcept.description: Describes the Resources and Locations required to meet an operational scenario from an integrated systems point of view. It is used to communicate overall quantitative and qualitative system characteristics to stakeholders.

ISO8601DateTime.name: ISO8601DateTime
ISO8601DateTime.description: A date and time specified in the ISO8601 date-time format including timezone designator (TZD): YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssTZD.

ImpactedBy.name: ImpactedBy
ImpactedBy.description: A dependency relationship denoting that a Capability is affected by an Opportunity.
constraints:
In case of value for ImpactedBy.client is stereotyped:
a. by any of specializations of «Architecture», values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Challenge» or its specializations,
b. by any of specializations of «ActualStrategicPhase», values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Challenge» or its specializations,
c. «OperationalActivity» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Challenge» or its specializations,
d. «Capability» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Opportunity» or its specializations,
e. «ActualOutcome» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «EnterpriseGoal» or its specializations.

In case of value for ImpactedBy.supplier is stereotyped:
a. «Challenge» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «Architecture» or «ActualStrategicPhase», or «OperationalActivity» or its specializations,
b. «Opportunity» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «Capability» or its specializations,
c. «EnterpriseGoal» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ActualOutcome» or its specializations.

Implements.name: Implements
Implements.description: An abstraction relationship that defines how an element in the upper layer of abstraction is implemented by a semantically equivalent element (for example tracing the Functions to the OperationalActivities) in the lower level of abstraction.
constraints:
In case of value for Implements.supplier is stereotyped:
a. by any of specializations of «OperationalAgent», values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «ResourcePerformer»,
b. «OperationalActivity» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «Function» or its specializations,
c. «ServiceFunction» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «Function» or its specializations,
d. «ServiceInterface» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceInterface» or its specializations,
e. «OperationalInterface» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceInterface» or its specializations,
f. «OperationalConnector» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceConnector» or its specializations,
g. «OperationalExchange» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceExchange» or its specializations,
g. «OperationalRole» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceRole» or its specializations,
h. «ResourceConnector» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceConnector» or its specializations,
i. «OperationalInformation» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceInformation» or its specializations.
j. by any of specializations of «ActualStrategicPhase», values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «Architecture», «OperationalActivity», or «Function».
k. «Service» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceService» or its specializations.
l. «StrategicInformation» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalInformation» or its specializations.

In case of value for Implements.client is stereotyped:
a. by any of specializations of «ResourcePerformer», values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «OperationalAgent»,
b. «Function» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalActivity», «ServiceFunction», «ActualStrategicPhase», or their specializations,
c. «ResourceInterface» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceInterface», «OperationalInterface», or their specializations,
d. «ResourceConnector» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalConnector», «ResourceConnector» or their specializations,
e. «ResourceExchange» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalExchange» or its specializations,
f. «ResourceRole» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalRole» or its specializations,
g. «OperationalActivity» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «ActualStrategicPhase» or its specializations,
h. «ResourceInformation» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalInformation» or its specializations.
i. by any of specializations of «Architecture», values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «ActualStrategicPhase».
j. «ResourceService» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Service» or its specializations.
k. «OperationalInformation» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «StrategicInformation» or its specializations.
l. «ServiceInterface» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalInterface» or its specializations.

Information.name: Information
Information.description: A comment that describes the state of an item of interest in any medium or form -- and is communicated or received.

properties.name: informationKind
properties.description: Captures the kind of information.

constraints: Value for the annotatedElement metaproperty must be stereotyped by a specialization of «UAFElement».

InformationModel.name: InformationModel
InformationModel.description: A structural specification of information types, showing relationships between them. The type of information captured in the InformationModel is described using the enumeration InformationModelKind (Conceptual, Logical, and Physical).

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Captures the kind of DataModel being represented, Conceptual, Logical or Physical.

IsCapableToPerform.name: IsCapableToPerform
IsCapableToPerform.description: An Abstraction relationship defining the traceability between the structural elements to the Activities that they can perform.
constraints:
In case of value for IsCapableToPerform.supplier is stereotyped:
a. «OperationalActivity» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «OperationalAgent»,
b. «ServiceFunction» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «Service» or its specializations,
c. «Function» or its specializations, except for «ProjectActivity», values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «ResourcePerformer»,
d. «ProjectActivity» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «Project».

In case of value for IsCapableToPerform.client is stereotyped:
a. by a specialization of «OperationalAgent», values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalActivity» or its specializations,
b. «Service» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceFunction» or its specializations,
c. by a specialization of «ResourcePerformer», values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Function» or its specializations, except for «ProjectActivity»,
d. by a specialization of «Project», values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «ProjectActivity» or its specializations.

KnownResource.name: KnownResource
KnownResource.description: Asserts that a known ResourcePerformer constrains the implementation of the OperationalPerformer that plays the role in the OperationalArchitecture.

Location.name: Location
Location.description: A specification of the generic area in which a LocationHolder is required to be located.

properties.name: customKind
properties.description: Captures the kind of Location if the LocationTypeKind has been set to "OtherType".

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Captures the kind of Location.

LocationHolder.name: LocationHolder
LocationHolder.description: Abstract grouping used to define elements that are allowed to be associated with a Location.

properties.name: physicalLocation
properties.description: Relates a LocationHolder (i.e. OperationalRole, ResourceRole) to its ActualLocation.

properties.name: requiredEnvironment
properties.description: Relates a LocationHolder  (i.e. OperationalRole, ResourceRole) to the Condition in which it is required to perform/be used.

MapsToCapability.name: MapsToCapability
MapsToCapability.description: An Abstraction relationship denoting that an Activity contributes to providing a Capability.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped a specialization of «Activity».
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Capability».

MapsToGoal.name: MapsToGoal
MapsToGoal.description: A dependency relationship denoting that some StrategicInformation contributes to achieving an EnterpriseGoal or Objective.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «StrategicInformation».
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «EnterpriseGoal» or its specializations.

MeasurableElement.name: MeasurableElement
MeasurableElement.description: Abstract grouping for elements that can be measured by applying MeasurementSets to them.

properties.name: measurementSet
properties.description: Relates the MeasurableElement to the MeasurementSet that provides its Measurements by which it can be measured.

properties.name: actualMeasurementSet
properties.description: Relates the MeasurableElement to the ActualMeasurementSet that provides its ActualMeasurements.

Measurement.name: Measurement
Measurement.description: A property of an element representing something in the physical world, expressed in amounts of a unit of measure.

properties.name: environmentalContext
properties.description: Relates the Measurement to the Condition (which provides the environementalContext) under which the Measurement is expected to be taken.

constraints: Value for the class metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «PropertySet».

properties.name: appliesFor
properties.description: Relates the MeasurementSet to the MeasurableElement that it is applicable to.

Metadata.name: Metadata
Metadata.description: A comment that can be applied to any element in the architecture. The attributes associated with this element details the relationship between the element and its related dublinCoreElement, metaDataScheme, category and name. This allows the element to be referenced using the Semantic Web.

properties.name: dublinCoreElement
properties.description: A metadata category that is a DublinCore tag.

properties.name: metaDataScheme
properties.description: A representation scheme that defines a set of Metadata.

properties.name: name
properties.description: The name of the Metadata.

properties.name: category
properties.description: Defines the category of a Metadata element example: http://purl.org/dc/terms/abstract.

constraints: Value for the annotatedElement metaproperty must be stereotyped by a specialization of «UAFElement».

MilestoneDependency.name: MilestoneDependency
MilestoneDependency.description: A dependency relationship between two ActualProjectMilestones that denotes one ActualProjectMilestone follows from another.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ActualProjectMilestone» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «ActualProjectMilestone» or its specializations.

Mission.name: Mission
Mission.description: The task, together with the purpose, that clearly indicates the action to be taken and the reasoning behind the mission. (JP 1-02)

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Selection of the enumerated kind for this element.

properties.name: customKind
properties.description: Identification of a special kind of Mission that is different from one of the predefined enumerated kinds.

MissionEngineeringThread.name: MissionEngineeringThread
MissionEngineeringThread.description: A sequence of end-to-end mission-related functions, actions, and events presented as a series of steps that implements a mission thread.

MissionScenario.name: MissionScenario
MissionScenario.description: Description of the geographical location and time frame of the overall conflict. A scenario includes information such as threat and friendly politico-military contexts and backgrounds, assumptions, constraints, limitations, strategic objectives, and other planning considerations. (OUSD(R&E))

MissionTask.name: MissionTask
MissionTask.description: A clearly defined activity specifically to be assigned to system, person, or organization that must be completed

MissionTaskAction.name: MissionTaskAction
MissionTaskAction.description: The usage of a MissionTask within a MissionThread
constraints: Value for activity metaproperty must be stereotyped «MissionTask» or its specializations.
Value for the activity metaproperty must be stereotyped «MissionThread» or its specializations.

MissionThread.name: MissionThread
MissionThread.description: A sequence of end-to-end mission tasks, activities, and events presented as a series of steps to achieve a mission. (OUSD(R&E))

MissionVignette.name: MissionVignette
MissionVignette.description: Description of the geographical location and time frame of the overall conflict. A vignette includes information such as threat and friendly politico-military contexts and backgrounds, assumptions, constraints, limitations, strategic objectives, and other planning considerations. It can represent small, ideally self-contained parts of a scenario. (OUSD(R&E))

Mitigates.name: Mitigates
Mitigates.description: A dependency relating a Security Control to a Risk. Mitigation is established to manage risk and could be represented as an overall strategy or through techniques (mitigation configurations) and procedures (SecurityProcesses).
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «SecurityControl» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Risk» or its specializations.

MotivatedBy.name: MotivatedBy
MotivatedBy.description: A dependency relationship denoting the reason or reasons one has for acting or behaving in a particular way
constraints:
In case of value for ImpactedBy.client is stereotyped:
a. «Opportunity» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Challenge» or its specializations,
b. «EnterpriseGoal» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Driver» or its specializations.

In case of value for ImpactedBy.supplier is stereotyped:
a. «Challenge» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «Opportunity» or its specializations,
b. «Driver» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «EnterpriseGoal» or its specializations.

MotivationalElement.name: MotivationalElement
MotivationalElement.description: An abstract kind of element in the model that provides the reason or reasons one has for acting or behaving in a particular way

properties.name: ID
properties.description: Numerical identifier for tracking and sorting Motivational Elements.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Description of a Motivational Element.

NaturalResource.name: NaturalResource
NaturalResource.description: Type of physical resource that occurs in nature such as oil, water, gas or coal.

OperationalActivity.name: OperationalActivity
OperationalActivity.description: An Activity that captures a logical process, specified independently of how the process is carried out.

properties.name: affectedResource
properties.description: A collection of OperationalExchangeItems consumed and produced internally within the OperationalActivity.

constraints: The values for the ownedParameter metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalParameter» or its specializations.

OperationalActivityAction.name: OperationalActivityAction
OperationalActivityAction.description: A call of an OperationalActivity in the context of another OperationalActivity.
constraints: Value for activity metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalActivity» or its specializations.
Value for the activity metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalActivity» or its specializations.

OperationalActivityEdge.name: OperationalActivityEdge
OperationalActivityEdge.description: Abstract grouping for OperationalControlFlow and OperationalObjectFlow.
constraints: «OperationalActivityEdge» must be owned directly or indirectly by «OperationalActivity» or its specializations.

OperationalAgent.name: OperationalAgent
OperationalAgent.description: An abstract type grouping OperationalArchitecture and OperationalPerformer.
constraints: Values for the ownedPort metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalPort» or its specializations.
Values for the ownedOperation metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalMethod» or its specializations.
Is capable of performing only «OperationalActivity» elements or its specializations.

OperationalArchitecture.name: OperationalArchitecture
OperationalArchitecture.description: An element used to denote a model of the Architecture, described from the Operational perspective.

OperationalAsset.name: OperationalAsset
OperationalAsset.description: An abstract element used to group the elements of OperationalAgent and OperationalInformation allowing them to own OperationalInformationRoles.

OperationalConnector.name: OperationalConnector
OperationalConnector.description: A Connector that goes between OperationalRoles representing a need to exchange Resources. It can carry a number of OperationalExchanges.
constraints: The value for the role metaproperty for the owned ConnectorEnd must be stereotype «OperationalRole»/«OperationalPort» or its specializations.

OperationalConstraint.name: OperationalConstraint
OperationalConstraint.description: A Rule governing an operational architecture element i.e. OperationalPerformer, OperationalActivity, OperationalInformation etc.
constraints: Value for the constrainedElement metaproperty must be stereotyped by any specialization of «SubjectOfOperationalConstraint».

OperationalControlFlow.name: OperationalControlFlow
OperationalControlFlow.description: An ActivityEdge that shows the flow of control between OperationalActivityActions.
constraints: Value for the target metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalActivityAction» or its specializations.
Value for the source metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalActivityAction» or its specializations.

OperationalExchange.name: OperationalExchange
OperationalExchange.description: Asserts that a flow can exist between OperationalPerformers (i.e. flows of information, people, materiel, or energy).

properties.name: exchangeKind
properties.description: Captures the kind of Resource being exchanged.

properties.name: trustLevel
properties.description: Captures the directional arbitrary level of trust related to an OperationalExchange between two OperationalPerformers.

constraints: Value for realizingConnector metaproperty has to be stereotyped «OperationalConnector» or its specializations.
Value for realizingActivityEdge metaproperty has to be stereotyped by any specialization of «OperationalActivityEdge».
Value for informationSource metaproperty has to be stereotyped «OperationalPerformer» or its specializations.
Value for informationTarget metaproperty has to be stereotyped «OperationalPerformer» or its specializations.
Value for realizingMessage metaproperty has to be stereotyped «OperationalMessage» or its specializations.

In case of OperationalExchange.operationalExchangeKind:
= InformationExchange, the conveyed element must be stereotyped «OperationalInformation» or its specializations,
= MaterielExchange, the conveyed element must be stereotyped «ResourceArtifact» or its specializations,
= EnergyExchange, the conveyed element must be stereotyped «NaturalResource» or its specializations,
= OrganizationalExchange, the conveyed element must be stereotyped «OrganizationalResource» or its specializations,
= ConfigurationExchange, the conveyed element must be stereotyped «CapabilityConfiguration» or its specializations, or
= GeoPoliticalExtentExchange, the conveyed element must be stereotyped «GeoPoliticalExtentType» or its specializations.

OperationalExchangeItem.name: OperationalExchangeItem
OperationalExchangeItem.description: An abstract grouping for elements that defines the types of elements that can be exchanged between OperationalPerformers and conveyed by an OperationalExchange.

properties.name: activity
properties.description: A collection of OperationalActivities that consume and/or produce the OperationalExchangeItem internally.

OperationalInformation.name: OperationalInformation
OperationalInformation.description: An item of information that flows between OperationalPerformers and is produced and consumed by the OperationalActivities that the OperationalPerformers are capable to perform (see IsCapableToPerform).
constraints: Values for the owner metaproperty must be stereotyped «DataModel» or its specializations.

OperationalInformationRole.name: OperationalInformationRole
OperationalInformationRole.description: A usage of OperationalInformation that exists in the context of an OperationalAsset. It also allows the representation of the whole-part aggregation of OperationalInformation elements.
constraints: Value for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalInformation» or its specializations.
Value for the class metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «OperationalAsset».

OperationalInterface.name: OperationalInterface
OperationalInterface.description: A declaration that specifies a contract between the OperationalPerformer it is related to, and any other OperationalPerformers it can interact with.
constraints: Values for the ownedOperation metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalMethod» or its specializations.

OperationalMessage.name: OperationalMessage
OperationalMessage.description: Message for use in an operational interaction scenario which carries any of the subtypes of OperationalExchange.
constraints: Values for the receiveEvent.event.operation metaproperty must be stereotyped with «OperationalMethod» or its specializations.

OperationalMethod.name: OperationalMethod
OperationalMethod.description: A behavioral feature of an OperationalAgent whose behavior is specified in an OperationalActivity.
constraints: The values for the ownedParameter metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalParameter» or its specializations.
Value for the method metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalActivity» or its specializations.

OperationalMitigation.name: OperationalMitigation
OperationalMitigation.description: A set of OperationalPerformers intended to address against specific operational risks.

OperationalObjectFlow.name: OperationalObjectFlow
OperationalObjectFlow.description: An ActivityEdge that shows the flow of Resources (objects/information) between OperationalActivityActions.

OperationalParameter.name: OperationalParameter
OperationalParameter.description: An element that represents inputs and outputs of an OperationalActivity. It is typed by an OperationalExchangeItem.
constraints: Value for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped by specialization of «OperationalExchangeItem».

OperationalPerformer.name: OperationalPerformer
OperationalPerformer.description: A logical agent that IsCapableToPerform OperationalActivities which produce, consume and process Resources.

OperationalPort.name: OperationalPort
OperationalPort.description: An interaction point for an OperationalAgent through which it can interact with the outside environment and which is defined by an OperationalInterface.
constraints: Value for class metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalAgent» or its specializations.
Value for type metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalInterface» or its specializations.

OperationalRole.name: OperationalRole
OperationalRole.description: Usage of a OperationalPerformer or OperationalArchitecture in the context of another OperationalPerformer or OperationalArchitecture. Creates a whole-part relationship.
constraints: Value for type metaproperty must be stereotyped by a specialization of «OperationalAgent».
Value for class metaproperty must be stereotyped by a specialization of «OperationalAgent».

OperationalSignal.name: OperationalSignal
OperationalSignal.description: An OperationalSignal is a specification of a kind of communication between operational performers in which a reaction is asynchronously triggered in the receiver without a reply.

OperationalSignalProperty.name: OperationalSignalProperty
OperationalSignalProperty.description: A property of an OperationalSignal typed by OperationalExchangeItem. It enables OperationalExchangeItem e.g. OperationalInformation to be passed as arguments of the OperationalSignal.
constraints: Value for class metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalSignal» or its specializations.
Value for type metaproperty must be stereotyped by a specialization of «OperationalExchangeItem».

OperationalStateDescription.name: OperationalStateDescription
OperationalStateDescription.description: A state machine describing the behavior of a OperationalPerformer, depicting how the OperationalPerformer responds to various events and the actions.
constraints: Values for the owner metaproperty must be stereotyped with specializations of «OperationalAgent» .

Opportunity.name: Opportunity
Opportunity.description: An existing or potential favorable circumstance or combination of circumstances which can be advantageous for addressing enterprise Challenges.

OpposableElement.name: OpposableElement
OpposableElement.description: A type of element that is categorized to allow for it to have an Opposes relationship to some other opposable element

properties.name: designation
properties.description: Captures the kind of designation.

Opposes.name: Opposes
Opposes.description: A tuple that indicates an open clash between two opposing groups (or individuals). This means that elements in the model are fighting against each other or are providing strong resistance to progress towards some goals. Note to entry: By individual this does not indicate instances in the model.
constraints: Values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «OpposableElement».
Values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «OpposableElement».

Organization.name: Organization
Organization.description: A group of OrganizationalResources (Persons, Posts, Organizations and Responsibilities) associated for a particular purpose.

OrganizationInPhase.name: OrganizationInPhase
OrganizationInPhase.description: An abstraction relationship relating an ActualOrganization to an ActualStrategicPhase to denote that the ActualOrganization plays a role or is a stakeholder in an ActualStrategicPhase.
constraints: Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «ActualStrategicPhase».
Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ActualOrganization» or its specializations.

OrganizationalResource.name: OrganizationalResource
OrganizationalResource.description: An abstract element grouping for Organization, Person, Post and Responsibility.

OwnsProcess.name: OwnsProcess
OwnsProcess.description: A dependency relationship denoting that an ActualOrganizationResource owns an OperationalActivity.
constraints: Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalActivity» or its specializations.
Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ActualOrganizationalResource» or its specializations.

OwnsRisk.name: OwnsRisk
OwnsRisk.description: An abstraction relating a Risk to an organizational resource that is responsible for executing the risk mitigation.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «OrganizationalResource» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Risk» or its specializations.

OwnsRiskInContext.name: OwnsRiskInContext
OwnsRiskInContext.description: An abstraction relating a Risk to an organizational role that is responsible for executing the risk mitigation in the specific context or configuration.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceRole» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Risk» or its specializations.

OwnsValue.name: OwnsValue
OwnsValue.description: An abstraction relationship denoting that an ActualOrganizationalResource owns a ValueItem
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «ActualOrganizationalResource».
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «ValueItem» or its specializations.

PerformsInContext.name: PerformsInContext
PerformsInContext.description: An abstraction relationship that relates an OperationalAction to a OperationalRole, or a FunctionAction to a ResourceRole. It indicates that the action can be carried out by the role when used in a specific context or configuration.
constraints:
In case of value for PerformsInContext.supplier is stereotyped:
a. «OperationalActivityAction» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalRole» or its specializations,
b. «ServiceFunctionAction» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceRole» or its specializations,
c. «FunctionAction» or its specializations, except for «ProjectActivityAction», values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceRole» or its specializations.
d. «ProjectActivityAction» or its specializations, values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ProjectRole» or its specializations.

In case of value for PerformsInContext.client is stereotyped:
a. «OperationalRole» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalActivityAction» or its specializations,
b. «ServiceRole» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceFunctionAction» or its specializations,
c. «ResourceRole» or its specializations, values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «FunctionAction» or its specializations.

Person.name: Person
Person.description: A type of a human being used to define the characteristics that need to be described for ActualPersons (e.g. properties such as address, telephone number, nationality, etc).

PhaseableElement.name: PhaseableElement
PhaseableElement.description: An abstract element that indicates the types of elements that can be assigned to a specific ActualStrategicPhase.

Phases.name: Phases
Phases.description: An abstraction relationship that exists between a PhaseableElement and an ActualStrategicPhase that it is assigned to.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «ActualStrategicPhase».
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «PhaseableElement».

PhysicalResource.name: PhysicalResource
PhysicalResource.description: An abstract grouping that defines physical resources (i.e. OrganizationalResource, ResourceArtifact and NaturalResource).

Post.name: Post
Post.description: A type of job title or position that a person can fill (e.g. Lawyer, Solution Architect, Machine Operator or Chief Executive Officer).

PresentedBy.name: PresentedBy
PresentedBy.description: A dependency relationship denoting that a Challenge must be overcome for addressing a Driver.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «Challenge» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Driver» or its specializations.

ProblemDomain.name: ProblemDomain
ProblemDomain.description: A property associated with an OperationalArchitecture, used to specify the scope of the problem.
constraints: Value for the class metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalArchitecture» or its specializations.
Value for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalPerformer» or its specializations.

Project.name: Project
Project.description: A type that represents a planned endeavor executed by an ActualOrganization responsible for developing, deploying or decommissioning ResourcePerformers in accordance with ActualProjectMilestones.

ProjectActivity.name: ProjectActivity
ProjectActivity.description: An activity carried out during a project.

ProjectActivityAction.name: ProjectActivityAction
ProjectActivityAction.description: The ProjectActivityAction is defined as a call behavior action that invokes the activity that needs to be preformed.
constraints: Value for the activity metaproperty must be stereotyped «ProjectActivity» or its specializations.
Value for the behavior metaproperty must be stereotyped «ProjectActivity» or its specializations.

ProjectMilestone.name: ProjectMilestone
ProjectMilestone.description: A type of event in a Project by which progress is measured.

properties.name: resource
properties.description: Relates a ProjectMilestone to the  Resources that can be affected by the milestone. It is used to describe aspects of the lifecycle of a Resource.

constraints: All of the «ProjectThemes», owned by a «ProjectMilestone», must be typed by the same «StatusIndicators» or its specializations.

ProjectMilestoneRole.name: ProjectMilestoneRole
ProjectMilestoneRole.description: The role played by a ProjectMilestone in the context of a Project.
constraints: Value for the class metaproperty must be stereotyped «Project» or its specializations.
Value for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped «ProjectMilestone» or its specializations.

ProjectRole.name: ProjectRole
ProjectRole.description: Usage of a Project in the context of another Project. Creates a whole-part relationship.
constraints: Value for the class metaproperty must be stereotyped «Project» or its specializations.
Value for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped «Project» or its specializations.

ProjectSequence.name: ProjectSequence
ProjectSequence.description: A dependency relationship between two ActualProjects that denotes one ActualProject cannot start before the previous ActualProject is finished.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «ActualProject» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «ActualProject» or its specializations.

ProjectStatus.name: ProjectStatus
ProjectStatus.description: The status (i.e. level of progress) of a ProjectTheme for an ActualProject at the time of the ActualProjectMilestone.
constraints: Value for the DefiningFeature metaproperty must be stereotyped «ProjectTheme» or its specializations.

ProjectTheme.name: ProjectTheme
ProjectTheme.description: A property of a ProjectMilestone that captures an aspect by which the progress of ActualProjects may be measured.
constraints: Value for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped «StatusIndicators» or its specializations.
Value for the class metaproperty must be stereotyped «ProjectMilestone» or its specializations.

PropertySet.name: PropertySet
PropertySet.description: An abstract grouping of architectural elements that can own Measurements.

Protects.name: Protects
Protects.description: A dependency that asserts that a SecurityControl is required to protect an Asset.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «SecurityControl» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped bu the specialization of «Asset».

ProtectsInContext.name: ProtectsInContext
ProtectsInContext.description: A dependency relationship that relates a SecurityControlAction to a OperationalRole, or a ResourceRole. It indicates that SecurityControl is required to protect an Asset in a specific context or configuration.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «SecurityControl» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «AssetRole» or its specializations.

Protocol.name: Protocol
Protocol.description: A Standard for communication over a network. Protocols may be composite, represented as a ProtocolStack made up of ProtocolLayers.

ProtocolImplementation.name: ProtocolImplementation
ProtocolImplementation.description: An abstract grouping of architectural elements that can implement Protocols.

properties.name: implements
properties.description: Relates the ResourceConnector and ResourcePort to the Protocols that they can implement.

ProtocolLayer.name: ProtocolLayer
ProtocolLayer.description: Usage of a Protocol in the context of another Protocol. Creates a whole-part relationship.
constraints: Value for the class metaproperty must be stereotyped «Protocol» or its specializations.
Value for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped «Protocol» or its specializations.

ProtocolStack.name: ProtocolStack
ProtocolStack.description: A sub-type of Protocol that contains the ProtocolLayers, defining a complete stack.

ProvidedServiceLevel.name: ProvidedServiceLevel
ProvidedServiceLevel.description: A sub type of ActualService that details a specific service level delivered by the provider.

ProvidesCompetence.name: ProvidesCompetence
ProvidesCompetence.description: A dependency relationship that asserts that an ActualOrganizationalResource provides a specific set of Competencies.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by a specialization of «ActualOrganizationalResource».
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Competence» or its specializations.

RequiredServiceLevel.name: RequiredServiceLevel
RequiredServiceLevel.description: A sub type of ActualService that details a specific service level required of the provider.

RequiresCompetence.name: RequiresCompetence
RequiresCompetence.description: An abstraction relationship that asserts that an ActualOrganizationalResource is required to have a specific set of Competencies.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped a specialization of «OrganizationalResource».
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «Competence» or its specializations.

Resource.name: Resource
Resource.description: Abstract element grouping for all elements that can be conveyed by an Exchange.

ResourceArchitecture.name: ResourceArchitecture
ResourceArchitecture.description: An element used to denote a model of the Architecture, described from the ResourcePerformer perspective.

ResourceArtifact.name: ResourceArtifact
ResourceArtifact.description: A type of man-made object that contains no human beings (i.e. satellite, radio, petrol, gasoline, etc.).

ResourceAsset.name: ResourceAsset
ResourceAsset.description: An abstract element used to group the elements of ResourcePerformer and ResourceInformation allowing them to own ResourceInformationRoles

ResourceConnector.name: ResourceConnector
ResourceConnector.description: A channel for exchange between two ResourceRoles.

properties.name: boundaryCondition
properties.description: Relates a ResourceConector to the extremes of the Environment in which it is required to be made available.

constraints: The value for the role metaproperty for the owned ConnectorEnd must be stereotype «ResourcePort», «ResourceRole» or their specializations.

ResourceConstraint.name: ResourceConstraint
ResourceConstraint.description: A rule governing the structural or functional aspects of an implementation.
constraints: Value for the constrainedElement metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «SubjectOfResourceConstraint».

ResourceExchange.name: ResourceExchange
ResourceExchange.description: Asserts that a flow can exist between ResourcePerformers (i.e. flows of data, people, materiel, or energy).

properties.name: exchangeKind
properties.description: Captures the kind of ResourceExchange.

constraints:
In case of ResourceExchange.exchangeKind:
= ResourceCommunication, the conveyed element must be stereotyped «DataElement» or its specializations,
= ResourceMovement, the conveyed element must be stereotyped by the specialization of  «PhysicalResource»,
= ResourceEnergyFlow, the conveyed element must be stereotyped «NaturalResource» or its specializations,
= GeoPoliticalExtentExchange, the conveyed element must be stereotyped «GeoPoliticalExtentType» or its specializations.
Value for the realizingActivityEdge metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «FunctionEdge».
Value for the realizingConnector metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceConnector» or its specializations.
Value for the informationSource metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «ResourcePerformer».
Value for the informationTarget metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «ResourcePerformer».
Value for the realizingMessage metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceMessage» or its specializations.

ResourceExchangeItem.name: ResourceExchangeItem
ResourceExchangeItem.description: An abstract grouping for elements that defines the types of elements that can be exchanged between ResourcePerformers and conveyed by a ResourceExchange.

properties.name: function
properties.description: Function using the ResourceExchangeItem internally.

ResourceInformation.name: ResourceInformation
ResourceInformation.description: A formalized representation of information that is managed by or exchanged between systems.
constraints: Values for the owner metaproperty must be stereotyped «InformationModel» or its specializations.

ResourceInformationRole.name: ResourceInformationRole
ResourceInformationRole.description: A usage of ResourceInformation that exists in the context of a ResourceAsset. It also allows the representation of the whole-part aggregation of ResourceInformation elements.
constraints: Value for the class metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «ResourceAsset».
Value for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceInformation» or its specializations.

ResourceInterface.name: ResourceInterface
ResourceInterface.description: A declaration that specifies a contract between the ResourcePerformers it is related to and any other ResourcePerformers it can interact with. It is also intended to be an implementation of a specification of an Interface in the Business and/or Service layer.
constraints: Values for ownedOperation metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceMethod» or its specializations.

ResourceMessage.name: ResourceMessage
ResourceMessage.description: Message for use in a Resource Event-Trace which carries any of the subtypes of ResourceExchange.
constraints: Values for the receiveEvent.event.operation metaproperty must be stereotyped with «ResourceMethod» or its specializations.

ResourceMethod.name: ResourceMethod
ResourceMethod.description: A behavioral feature of a ResourcePerformer whose behavior is specified in a Function.
constraints: Value for the method metaproperty must be stereotyped «Function» or its specializations.
The values for the ownedParameter metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceParameter».

ResourceMitigation.name: ResourceMitigation
ResourceMitigation.description: A set of ResourcePerformers intended to address against specific risks.

ResourceParameter.name: ResourceParameter
ResourceParameter.description: An element that represents inputs and outputs of a Function. It is typed by a ResourceInteractionItem.
