constraints: Value for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped with a specialization of «ResourceInteractionItem».

ResourcePerformer.name: ResourcePerformer
ResourcePerformer.description: An abstract grouping of elements that can perform Functions.

properties.name: milestone
properties.description: Relates ResourcePerformer to ProjectMilestones that affect it.

properties.name: isStandardConfiguration
properties.description: Indicates if the ResourcePerformer is StandardConfiguration, default=false.

constraints: Values for the ownedOperation metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceMethod» or its specializations.
Values for the ownedPort metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourcePort» or its specializations.
Is capable of performing only «Function» elements or its specializations.

ResourcePort.name: ResourcePort
ResourcePort.description: An interaction point for a ResourcePerformer through which it can interact with the outside environment and which is defined by a ResourceInterface.
constraints: Value for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceInterface» or its specializations.
Value for the class metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «ResourcePerformer».

ResourceRole.name: ResourceRole
ResourceRole.description: Usage of a ResourcePerformer in the context of another ResourcePerformer. Creates a whole-part relationship.

properties.name: roleKind
properties.description: Captures the kind of role a Resource can play.

constraints: Value for the class metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «ResourcePerformer».
Value for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «ResourcePerformer».

ResourceService.name: ResourceService
ResourceService.description: A services that a ResourcePerformer provides to support higher level Services or OperationalActivities. Employee provisioning, backup and recovery, storage, self-service help desk are examples of ResourceServices.

ResourceServiceInterface.name: ResourceServiceInterface
ResourceServiceInterface.description: A contract that defines the ResourceMethods and ResourceSignal receptions that the ResourceServices realize.

ResourceSignal.name: ResourceSignal
ResourceSignal.description: A ResourceSignal is a specification of a kind of communication between resources (ResourcePerformers) in which a reaction is asynchronously triggered in the receiver without a reply.

ResourceSignalProperty.name: ResourceSignalProperty
ResourceSignalProperty.description: A property of an ResourceSignal typed by ResourceExchangeItem. It enables ResourceExchangeItem e.g. ResourceInformation to be passed as arguments of the ResourceSignal.
constraints: Value for class metaproperty must be stereotyped «ResourceSignal» or its specializations.
Value for type metaproperty must be stereotyped by a specialization of «ResourceExchangeItem».

ResourceStateDescription.name: ResourceStateDescription
ResourceStateDescription.description: A state machine describing the behavior of a ResourcePerformer, depicting how the ResourcePerformer responds to various events and the actions.
constraints: Values for the owner metaproperty must be stereotyped with the specialization of «ResourcePerformer».

Responsibility.name: Responsibility
Responsibility.description: The type of duty required of a Person or Organization.

ResponsibleFor.name: ResponsibleFor
ResponsibleFor.description: An abstraction relationship between an ActualResponsibleResource and an ActualResponsibility or ActualProject. It defines the duties that the ActualResponsibleResource is ResponsibleFor.

properties.name: responsibleRoleKind
properties.description: Captures the kind of role (Manager or ResponsibleOwner) responsible for the ActualProject or ActualResponsibility.

properties.name: startDate
properties.description: Start date of an ActualResponsibleResource being ResponsibleFor and ActualProject or ActualResponsibility.

properties.name: endDate
properties.description: End date of an ActualResponsibleResource being ResponsibleFor and ActualProject or ActualResponsibility.

constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «ActualResponsibleResource».
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped  «ActualProject», «ActualResponsibility», «ActualProjectMilestone» or their specializations.

Risk.name: Risk
Risk.description: A type that represents a situation involving exposure to danger of AffectableElements (e.g. Assets, Processes, Capabilities, Opportunities, or Enterprise Goals) where the effects of such exposure can be characterized in terms of the likelihood of occurrence of a given threat and the potential adverse consequences of that threat's occurrence.

Rule.name: Rule
Rule.description: An abstract grouping for all types of constraint (i.e. an OperationalConstraint could detail the rules of accountancy best practice).

properties.name: ruleKind
properties.description: Captures the kind of Rule that is being described.

SameAs.name: SameAs
SameAs.description: A dependency relationship that asserts that two elements refer to the same real-world thing.
constraints: Values for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «UAFElement».
Values for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «UAFElement».

SecurityConstraint.name: SecurityConstraint
SecurityConstraint.description: A type of rule that captures a formal statement to define security laws, regulations, guidances, and policy.
constraints: Value for the constrainedElement metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «SubjectOfSecurityConstraint».

SecurityControl.name: SecurityControl
SecurityControl.description: The management, operational, and technical control (i.e., safeguard or countermeasure) prescribed for an information system to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the system and its information [NIST SP 800-53].

properties.name: mitigatingActualResource
properties.description: Relates an actual mitigation (an ActualResource for mitigating a Risk) to a SecurityControl.

SecurityControlFamily.name: SecurityControlFamily
SecurityControlFamily.description: An element that organizes security controls into a family. Each Security Control Family contains security controls related to the general security topic of the family.

SecurityEnclave.name: SecurityEnclave
SecurityEnclave.description: Collection of information systems connected by one or more internal networks under the control of a single authority and security policy. The systems may be structured by physical proximity or by function, independent of location.

SecurityProcess.name: SecurityProcess
SecurityProcess.description: The security-related procedure that satisfies the security control requirement.

SecurityProcessAction.name: SecurityProcessAction
SecurityProcessAction.description: A call of a SecurityProcess in the context of another SecurityProcess.
constraints: Value for behavior metaproperty must be stereotyped «SecurityProcess» or its specializations.

SecurityRisk.name: SecurityRisk
SecurityRisk.description: The level of impact on enterprise operations, assets, or individuals resulting from the operation of an information system given the potential impact of a threat and the likelihood of that threat occurring [NIST SP 800-65].

Sequence.name: Sequence
Sequence.description: A dependency relationship that asserts one Individual's temporal extent is completely before the temporal extent of another.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «ActualState».
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped by any of specializations of «ActualState».

Service.name: Service
Service.description: A mechanism to enable access to one or more capabilities, where the access is provided using a prescribed service interface and is exercised consistent with service constraints and policies.

ServiceArchitecture.name: ServiceArchitecture
ServiceArchitecture.description: An element used to denote a model of the Architecture, described from the Services perspective.

ServiceConnector.name: ServiceConnector
ServiceConnector.description: A channel for exchange between two Services. Where one acts as the consumer of the other.
constraints: The value for the role metaproperty for the owned ConnectorEnd must be stereotyped «ServicePort», «ServiceRole» or their specializations.

ServiceContract.name: ServiceContract
ServiceContract.description: A constraint governing the use of one or more Services.

properties.name: constrainedExchanges
properties.description: OperationalExchanges constrained to be carried out by the Service GovernedBy this ServiceContract.

constraints: Values for constrainedElement metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalConnector» or its specializations.

ServiceControlFlow.name: ServiceControlFlow
ServiceControlFlow.description: An ActivityEdge that shows the flow of control between ServiceFunctionActions.
constraints: Value for the source metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceFunctionAction» or its specializations.
Value for the target metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceFunctionAction» or its specializations.

ServiceExchange.name: ServiceExchange
ServiceExchange.description: Asserts that a flow can exist between Services (i.e. flows of information, people, materiel, or energy).

properties.name: exchangeKind
properties.description: Captures the kind of Resource being exchanged.

constraints: Value for conveyed metaproperty has to be stereotyped by any of specializations of «ServiceExchangeItem».
Value for informationSource metaproperty has to be stereotyped «Service» or its specializations.
Value for informationTarget metaproperty has to be stereotyped «Service» or its specializations.
Value for the realizingActivityEdge metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «ServiceFunctionEdge».
Value for the realizingConnector metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceConnector» or its specializations.
Value for the realizingMessage metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceMessage» or its specializations.

ServiceExchangeItem.name: ServiceExchangeItem
ServiceExchangeItem.description: An abstract grouping for elements that defines the types of elements that can be exchanged between Services and conveyed by a ServiceExchange.

ServiceFunction.name: ServiceFunction
ServiceFunction.description: An Activity that describes the abstract behavior of Services, regardless of the actual implementation.
constraints: The values for the ownedParameter metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceParameter».

ServiceFunctionAction.name: ServiceFunctionAction
ServiceFunctionAction.description: A call of a ServiceFunction in the context of another ServiceFunction.
constraints: Value for the activity metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceFunction» or its specializations.
Value for the behavior metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceFunction» or its specializations.

ServiceFunctionEdge.name: ServiceFunctionEdge
ServiceFunctionEdge.description: Abstract grouping for ServiceControlFlow and ServiceObjectFlow.
constraints: «ServiceFunctionEdge» must be owned directly or indirectly by «ServiceFunction» or its specializations.

ServiceInterface.name: ServiceInterface
ServiceInterface.description: A contract that defines the ServiceMethods and ServiceSignals that the Service realizes.
constraints: Values for the ownedOperation metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceMethod» or its specializations.

ServiceMessage.name: ServiceMessage
ServiceMessage.description: Message for use in a services interaction scenario which carries any of the subtypes of ServiceExchange.
constraints: Values for the receiveEvent.event.operation metaproperty must be stereotyped with «ServiceMethod» or its specializations.

ServiceMethod.name: ServiceMethod
ServiceMethod.description: A behavioral feature of a Service whose behavior is specified in a ServiceFunction.
constraints: The values for the ownedParameter metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceParameter» or its specializations.
Value for the method metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceFunction» or its specializations.
The values for the owner metaproperty must be stereotyped «Service» or its specializations.

ServiceObjectFlow.name: ServiceObjectFlow
ServiceObjectFlow.description: An ActivityEdge that shows the flow of Resources (objects/information) between ServiceFunctionActions.

ServiceParameter.name: ServiceParameter
ServiceParameter.description: An element that represents inputs and outputs of a ServiceFunction, represents inputs and outputs of a Service.
constraints: The values for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped a specialization of «ServiceExchangeItem».

ServicePolicy.name: ServicePolicy
ServicePolicy.description: A constraint governing the use of one or more Services.
constraints: Values for constrainedElement metaproperty must be stereotyped «Service» or its specializations.

ServicePort.name: ServicePort
ServicePort.description: An interaction point for a Service through which it can interact with the outside environment and which is defined by a ServiceInterface.
constraints: Value for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceInterface» or its specializations.
Value for the class metaproperty must be stereotyped «Service» or its specializations.

ServiceRole.name: ServiceRole
ServiceRole.description: Usage of a Service in the context of another Service. Creates a whole-part relationship.
constraints: Value for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped «Service» or its specializations.
Value for the class metaproperty must be stereotyped «Service» or its specializations.

ServiceSignal.name: ServiceSignal
ServiceSignal.description: A specification of a kind of communication between Services in which a reaction is asynchronously triggered in the receiver without a reply.

ServiceSignalProperty.name: ServiceSignalProperty
ServiceSignalProperty.description: A property of a ServiceSignal typed by ServiceExchangeItem. It enables ServiceExchangeItem e.g. OperationalInformation to be passed as arguments of the ServiceSignal.
constraints: Value for class metaproperty must be stereotyped «ServiceSignal» or its specializations.
Value for type metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «ServiceExchangeItem».

ServiceStateDescription.name: ServiceStateDescription
ServiceStateDescription.description: A state machine describing the behavior of a Service, depicting how the Service responds to various events and the actions.
constraints: Values for the owner metaproperty must be stereotyped «Service» or its specializations.

Software.name: Software
Software.description: A sub-type of ResourceArtifact that specifies an executable computer program.

Stakeholder.name: Stakeholder
Stakeholder.description: An individual organizational resource, or a type of organizational resource (both internal and external to the enterprise) who has an interest in, or is affected by, outcomes or intermediate effects generated or influenced by the enterprise.

properties.name: stakeholderConcern
properties.description: Relates a Stakeholder to a Concern.

Standard.name: Standard
Standard.description: A ratified and peer-reviewed specification that is used to guide or constrain the architecture. A Standard may be applied to any element in the architecture.

properties.name: ratifiedBy
properties.description: Relates a Standard to the ActualOrganization that ratified the Standard.

properties.name: mandatedDate
properties.description: The date when this version of the Standard was published.

properties.name: retiredDate
properties.description: The date when this version of the Standard was retired.

properties.name: publishedBy
properties.description: An entity responsible for making the resource available

properties.name: createdBy
properties.description: The organization or creator of the standard or doctrine

StandardOperationalActivity.name: StandardOperationalActivity
StandardOperationalActivity.description: A sub-type of OperationalActivity that is a standard operating procedure.

StatusIndicators.name: StatusIndicators
StatusIndicators.description: An enumerated type that specifies a status for a ProjectTheme.

StrategicAsset.name: StrategicAsset
StrategicAsset.description: An abstract element that indicates the types of strategic elements that can be affected by Risk.

StrategicExchange.name: StrategicExchange
StrategicExchange.description: Asserts that a flow can exist between ActualStrategicPhases (i.e. flows of information, people, materiel, or energy).
constraints: Value for conveyed metaproperty has to be stereotyped by any of specializations of «StrategicExchangeItem».
Value for informationSource metaproperty has to be stereotyped by any of specializations of «ActualStrategicPhase».
Value for informationTarget metaproperty has to be stereotyped by any of specializations of «ActualStrategicPhase».

StrategicExchangeItem.name: StrategicExchangeItem
StrategicExchangeItem.description: An abstract grouping for elements that defines the types of elements that can be exchanged between ActualStrategicPhases and conveyed by a StrategicExchange.

StrategicInformation.name: StrategicInformation
StrategicInformation.description: Knowledge communicated or received concerning a particular fact or circumstance that is strategic in nature that is important or essential in relation to a plan of action
constraints: Values for the owner metaproperty must be stereotyped «DataModel» or its specializations.

StrategicPhase.name: StrategicPhase
StrategicPhase.description: A type of a current or future phase of the enterprise, mission, ValueStream, or EnduringTask.

StructuralPart.name: StructuralPart
StructuralPart.description: Usage of a StrategicPhase in the context of another StrategicPhase. It asserts that one StrategicPhase is a spatial part of another. Creates a whole-part relationship that represents the structure of the StrategicPhase.
constraints: Value for class metaproperty must be stereotyped «StrategicPhase» or its specializations.
Value for type metaproperty must be stereotyped «StrategicPhase» or its specializations.

SubjectOfForecast.name: SubjectOfForecast
SubjectOfForecast.description: An abstract grouping of  elements that can be the subject of a Forecast.

SubjectOfOperationalConstraint.name: SubjectOfOperationalConstraint
SubjectOfOperationalConstraint.description: An abstract grouping of elements that can be the subject of an OperationalConstraint.

SubjectOfResourceConstraint.name: SubjectOfResourceConstraint
SubjectOfResourceConstraint.description: An abstract grouping of elements that can be the subject of a ResourceConstraint.

SubjectOfSecurityConstraint.name: SubjectOfSecurityConstraint
SubjectOfSecurityConstraint.description: An abstract grouping of elements that can be the subject of a SecurityConstraint.

SubjectOfStrategicConstraint.name: SubjectOfStrategicConstraint
SubjectOfStrategicConstraint.description: An abstract grouping of elements that can be the subject of a StrategicConstraint.

Supports.name: Supports
Supports.description: A abstraction relationship that asserts that a service in someway contributes or assists in the execution of an OperationalActivity.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «Service» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «OperationalActivity» or its specializations.

System.name: System
System.description: An integrated set of elements, subsystems, or assemblies that accomplish a defined objective. These elements include products (hardware, software, firmware), processes, people, information, techniques, facilities, services, and other support elements (INCOSE SE Handbook V4, 2015).

Technology.name: Technology
Technology.description: A sub type of ResourceArtifact that indicates a technology domain, i.e. nuclear, mechanical, electronic, mobile telephony etc.

TemporalPart.name: TemporalPart
TemporalPart.description: Usage of a StrategicPhase in the context of another StrategicPhase. It asserts that one StrategicPhase is a spatial part of another. Creates a whole-part relationship that represents the temporal structure of the StrategicPhase.
constraints: Value for class metaproperty must be stereotyped «EnterprisePhase» or its specializations.
Value for type metaproperty must be stereotyped «EnterprisePhase» or its specializations.

UAFElement.name: UAFElement
UAFElement.description: Abstract super type for all of the UAF elements. It provides a way for all of the UAF elements to have a common set of properties.

properties.name: conformsTo
properties.description: Relates a UAFElement to the Standard that the UAFElement is conforming to.

properties.name: URI
properties.description: Captures Unique identifier for the element.

ValueItem.name: ValueItem
ValueItem.description: An ideal, custom, or institution that an enterprise promotes or agrees with. It may be positive or negative, depending on point of view.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Captures the kind of ValueItem.

properties.name: customKind
properties.description: Captures the kind of ValueItem if the ValueItemKind has been set to "Other".

ValueStream.name: ValueStream
ValueStream.description: An end-to-end collection of activities that create a result for a customer, who may be the ultimate customer or an internal end-user of the value stream. Value stream nested within another value stream may represent Value Stream Stage - a distinct, identifiable phase or step within a value stream [The Business Architecture Metamodel Guide, 2020].

VersionOfConfiguration.name: VersionOfConfiguration
VersionOfConfiguration.description: A property of a WholeLifeConfiguration, used in version control of a VersionedElement. It asserts that a VersionedElement is a version of a WholeLifeConfiguration.
constraints: Value for the class metaproperty must be stereotyped «WholeLifeConfiguration» or its specializations.
Value for the type metaproperty must be stereotyped by the specialization of «VersionedElement».

VersionSuccession.name: VersionSuccession
VersionSuccession.description: A dependency relationship between two  VersionOfConfigurations that denotes that one VersionOfConfiguration follows from another.
constraints: Value for the client metaproperty must be stereotyped «VersionOfConfiguration» or its specializations.
Value for the supplier metaproperty must be stereotyped «VersionOfConfiguration» or its specializations.

VersionedElement.name: VersionedElement
VersionedElement.description: An abstract grouping of ResourcePerformer and Service that allows VersionOfConfiguration to be related to ActualProjectMilestones.

properties.name: versionReleasedAtMilestone
properties.description: Relates a VersionedElement to the ActualProjectMilestone. It indicates the ActualProjectMilestone at which the VersionedElement is released.

properties.name: versionWithdrawnAtMilestone
properties.description: Relates a VersionedElement to the ActualProjectMilestone. It indicates the ActualProjectMilestone at which the VersionedElement is withdrawn.

View.name: View
View.description: An information item, governed by an architecture viewpoint, comprising part of an architecture description that communicates some aspect of an architecture.

properties.name: viewpoint
properties.description: Relates the View to the Viewpoint that the View conforms to.

Viewpoint.name: Viewpoint
Viewpoint.description: Conventions for the creation, interpretation and use of an architecture view to frame one or more concerns that governs the creation of views.

properties.name: language
properties.description: The languages used to express the Viewpoint.

properties.name: method
properties.description: The methods employed in the development of the Viewpoint.

properties.name: purpose
properties.description: The purpose of the Viewpoint.

properties.name: stakeholder
properties.description: Relates the Viewpoint to the Stakeholders whose Concerns are being addressed by the Viewpoint.

properties.name: concern
properties.description: Relates the Viewpoint to the Concerns that the Viewpoint addresses.

VisionStatement.name: VisionStatement
VisionStatement.description: A type of comment that describes the future state of the enterprise, without regard to how it is to be achieved. http://www.omg.org/spec/BMM/1.3/
constraints: Values for annotatedElement metaproperty must be stereotyped «EnterpriseVision» or its specializations.

WholeLifeConfiguration.name: WholeLifeConfiguration
WholeLifeConfiguration.description: A set of VersionedElements, e.g. Services for a service provider or ResourcePerformers deployed for implementation.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Captures the kind of WholeLifeConfiguration.

WholeLifeEnterprise.name: WholeLifeEnterprise
WholeLifeEnterprise.description: A WholeLifeEnterprise is a purposeful endeavor of any size involving people, organizations and supporting systems. It is made up of TemporalParts and StructuralParts.
